name: Error Solis
summary: Error Solis is a 3D mobile space action RPG in development in Portugal for Android and iOS. Players create a pilot, fly and fight in real time, and progress through story-led contracts, regional travel, mining, salvage, stations, equipment and ship ownership. Its spacecraft designs draw on animals from Earth. Android and iPhone builds are in invitation-only testing through Google Play Internal Testing and TestFlight, respectively. No public release date has been announced.
